description: In MemoryBackend.import_email, the comment explicitly notes: 'Acquire a single lock that covers the duplicate check, thread assignment, and the actual insert — eliminating the TOCTOU race window.' A contributor might split this into separate lock acquisitions for clarity. But that would reintroduce a time-of-check/time-of-use race: two concurrent imports of the same Message-ID could both pass the duplicate check, then both insert, resulting in a duplicate. The single lock is the correct design for a Mutex-guarded in-memory store.
title: import_email acquires a single lock covering duplicate check + thread assignment + insert to eliminate TOCTOU race
